subject: Urban Planning
title: The Millennium Dome: A Tent Without a Purpose
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Millennium Dome: A Tent Without a Purpose usable.

hook.text: Britain spent £789 million on the Millennium Dome. It attracted half the expected visitors and became a national joke.

buildup.text: Built for the year 2000 celebration, the dome had no clear purpose after the party. It sat empty for years.

discovery.text: The project was rushed for a symbolic deadline. Critics said the content was like 'a theme park without rides.'

twist.text: It was eventually reborn as the O2 Arena — now one of the world's busiest concert venues. The building worked after all.

climax.text: Mega-events often leave white elephants. The O2 is the rare exception that found a second life.

punchline.text: The party lasted one year. The debt lasted twenty. The arena saved it.

quiz.question: What eventually saved the Millennium Dome from being a total failure?
options: The government converted it into a national museum
It was repurposed as the O2 Arena, a major concert venue
Private investors turned it into a luxury shopping center
